findings.name: Registry identities
findings.fact: NetherExp registers manipulation, fear, excitement, faith and anxiety in namespace netherman. Manipulator Stick is netherman:manipulator_stick. Four zone IDs use the otherwise empty neutral ZoneEffect class. Exact additional item/entity IDs remain in the pinned registration class, ready for final mapping.

findings.name: Manipulation is a client/server control package
findings.fact: In addition to the protected server aggro logic, ClientEffectEvents changes the affected local player's yaw by sin(rotationAngle)*0.8 and pitch by cos(rotationAngle*0.5)*0.3 after increasing the shared angle by 0.05 per player tick. It enqueues attack clicks with random 20..59-tick spacing. MovementInputUpdate scans x/z +/-10 and y +/-5 for the first lava/fire block, steers forward/left impulses toward it according to look-relative angle, or randomizes impulses to [-1,1) on every 15th player tick when no danger is found. These affect gameplay input and must not be excluded with purely cosmetic camera/overlay code. The static timers are not reset when the effect ends in these methods.

findings.name: Curios delivery
findings.fact: CuriosCompat queries the first curio whose stack is the Chance Totem and returns that actual stack, or null when absent. It is a distinct native accessory lookup path, sharing the previously pinned death handler after lookup.

findings.name: Crimson arrow ricochet
findings.fact: The shooter constructor assigns 5..10 bounces. On a block hit with bounces left it decrements the counter, reflects velocity v - n*(2*v dot n), scales it by 0.95, updates rotations and clears inGround/inGroundTime. At zero it delegates to the normal block impact. BouncesLeft is saved/loaded in NBT. No custom entity-hit source is introduced by this class. Other constructors start with default zero; source creation must be mapped rather than assumed equivalent.

findings.name: Azazel mask mechanics
findings.fact: Head-slot stages have a config-gated fire/lava/hot-floor incoming-damage cancellation. HIGHEST-priority death handling advances stages 0/1, sets HP=2, clears effects, adds vanilla Regeneration 900 amplifier 1, Fire Resistance 800 amplifier 0, Absorption 100 amplifier 1, and stores LastRegenTick in item CUSTOM_DATA. Stage 2 is consumed and invokes the relocation/effect package analogous to Chance Totem with HP=1. Worn damaged stages repair one stage when currentTick-LastRegenTick reaches MASK_REGEN_COOLDOWN. Exact configuration values, item properties and event ordering remain for final review.

findings.name: Zone consumers
findings.fact: ClientZoneAmbientEvents chooses ambient/boss audio according to Anxiety/Faith/Excitement/Fear. TotemusBlockEntity applies/removes Fear/Excitement/Faith markers and titles. Azazel's Anxiety producer/remover remains to be read in full before final exclusion of zone markers. Do not infer combat fear or stun from these registry names.
